  (5)

  (5)

  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze the importance of run time and compile time polymorphism in C++ with a  
  programming example.                                                                    (3)  
  
  C)      Explain the rules of virtual functions in C++.                                          (2)  
  5)           Explain the concept of stream class hierarchy in I/O systems.                           (5)
